subtraction.excerpt:
Step 1: Today ki date 2025-05-01 hai.
Step 2: Humein 3 days ago ki date nikalni hai.
Step 3: 2025-05-01 mein se 3 days minus karne padenge.
Step 4: 01 minus 3 karne par hum 31 April par aayenge.
Step 5: Isliye, 3 days ago ki date 2025-04-30 thi.

Answer: 2025-04-30

recurrence.excerpt:
Step 1: Aaj ki date 2025-06-27 hai. 
Step 2: Question mein clearly likha hai "Without counting today", matlab aaj ko hum 1st occurrence nahi maanenge. 
Step 3: Agar aaj ko count nahi karenge, toh pehli recurrence kal se start hogi. 
Step 4: 3 days ka interval hai, toh kal 2025-06-28 hoga pehla occurrence. 
Step 5: Iska matlab 2025-06-28 hi 1st occurrence ki date hai.

Answer: 2025-06-28

hindi.excerpt:
सबसे पहले, हमें दिए गए दोनों time के बीच का difference निकालना है। 

शुरुआती time है 19:52 और final time है 20:17। 
चूंकि 19:52 से 20:00 तक 8 minutes होते हैं, तो हम 17 minutes और add कर देंगे। 
8 + 17 = 25 minutes। 

या फिर, अगर हम 20:17 में से 19:52 subtract करें, तो भी 25 minutes ही आएगा। 

तो, 25 minutes बीत चुके हैं। 

Answer: 25

example_questions.date_subtraction: Today is 2025-05-01, what was the date 3 days ago?
example_questions.date_recurrence: Today is 2025-06-27, and I have a recurrence every 3 days. Without counting today, what is the date of the 1 occurrence?
